title: [Expense Agent] Travel request fixes: deletion after cancel, linked reports, approver audit user, closure history
summary: Four travel request improvements: deletion after report cancellation, linked reports visibility, approver user tracking in audit fields, and activity logging for request closure.
key_points: Travel requests can now be deleted after linked posted reports are canceled
New actions show all expense and posted expense reports linked to a travel request
Approve/reject audit fields now record the approver's BC user instead of session user
New Closed activity event logs when travel requests are closed
Permission sets updated for new functionality
